title: Sports & Recreation Equipment
description: Thin-wall contoured shapes (golf club heads, bike frames, tennis racket frames), often with variable wall thickness
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) offers the best strength-to-weight ratio for premium sports equipment. Grade 9 for frames requiring more forming.
Form: Near-net-shape forging for golf heads ensures optimal grain flow and consistent weight. Tube forming for bike frames.
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM B348 Grade 5 / Grade 9, annealed, 100% dimensional + weight check, anodized finish
